name: Ado-Trastuzumab Emtansine (T-DM1)
cyclesNote: Curative adjuvant: 14 cycles every 21 days for residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant taxane + trastuzumab-based therapy (KATHERINE trial). Metastatic: continuous until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026
source.primaryStudy: KATHERINE: von Minckwitz G, Huang CS, Mano MS, et al. N Engl J Med 2019;380:617-628; EMILIA: Verma S, et al. N Engl J Med 2012;367:1783-1791
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (NCCN v6.2026 BINV-M 4, 7 of 10; BINV-Q 4, 10 of 15)

biomarkers.note: HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (trastuzumab linked to emtansine / DM1 microtubule inhibitor): requires HER2-positive disease (IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified). Indicated as: (1) Category 1 preferred adjuvant therapy for residual invasive cancer in breast or nodes after preoperative taxane- and trastuzumab-containing therapy (KATHERINE trial); (2) Metastatic HER2-positive therapy (EMILIA trial). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: low-to-moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
Cardiac: evaluate LVEF before starting and periodically during therapy (every 3 months). Hold if LVEF decline occurs.
Thrombocytopenia & hepatotoxicity monitoring: monitor platelets and transaminases before each cycle (DeVita/KATHERINE safety).
Do not confuse with fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan; do not substitute trastuzumab and hyaluronidase-oysk for this agent.
monitoring: Platelet count and CBC before each cycle (thrombocytopenia)
Hepatic transaminases (ALT, AST, total bilirubin) before each cycle
LVEF at baseline and every 3 months during treatment
clearanceChecks: liver function tests (ALT/AST ≤ 2.5x ULN, bilirubin ≤ ULN)

doseModificationRules.text: Hold T-DM1 until platelets recover to grade ≤ 1 (≥ 75,000/mcL). Resume at reduced dose level: first reduction 3.0 mg/kg; second reduction 2.4 mg/kg. Permanently discontinue if unable to tolerate 2.4 mg/kg.
Hold T-DM1 until ALT/AST recover to grade ≤ 2 (≤ 5x ULN). Resume with one dose-level reduction.

doseModificationRules.condition: symptomatic congestive heart failure or LVEF < 40%

drugs.name: Ado-trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10 and BINV-Q 10 of 15. Ado-trastuzumab emtansine 3.6 mg/kg IV Day 1, cycled every 21 days (for 14 cycles in curative adjuvant residual setting; continuous until progression in metastatic setting).
